regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, graphical abstract, and metadata
regions.finding: Visually verified the actual title and current asymmetric acrylic-acid/allene [4+1] annulation class. The graphical abstract's 22 examples and up-to-99:1 er are aggregate evidence, not 22 extra experiments.

Separated three cited Pd carboxylic-acid C-H functionalization precedents from the authors' generic current acrylic-acid/allene design. Prior arrows were classified as literature examples; the current arrow is a general scheme.

regions.finding: Recorded the prior A-to-B route separately and five current isolated-arrow endpoints B-to-C, C-to-D, D-to-E, E-to-F, and F-to-Rh4. Ordered low-temperature alkylation and 250 °C microwave rearrangement remain separate stages. Preserved the B-to-C scheme/prose yield conflict (80% versus 84%).

Mapped Rh1-Rh4, nitrile-solvent, copper-oxidant, oxidant-loading, additive, and concentration results to the twelve Table 1 rows on page 3 without creating prose duplicates. The prose's BHT/entry-11 attribution conflicts with the table's BHA row and remains unresolved.

unresolved: B-to-C yield conflict: Scheme 2 prints 80%, while prose states 84% on gram scale.
Table/prose conflict for entry 11: table says BHA, prose says BHT.

regions.region: page 3 Table 1 reaction header, catalyst drawings, entries 1-12, and footnotes a-f

Entry 8 uses 100 umol oxidant; entry 9 uses 10 mol% TEMPO; entry 12 uses the full 10 mol%/10 mol%/0.5 equiv/2 equiv/0.2 M override.
